contributions.detail: Schedule A (PDF p2) carries FOUR entries in a 17-line grid: 250.00 + 500.00 + 1607.14 + 6000.00 = 8,357.14 exactly = the schedule's printed subtotal = its printed total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell. THE IN-KIND CONVENTION IS MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND HERE: the filer wrote a banner 'In kind:' on printed line 4 and the 1,607.14 James Child entry beneath it is that in-kind gift, and it is INSIDE the printed 8,357.14 — cash-only gives 6,750.00, which appears nowhere on the document. THE LOAN WAS CLASSIFIED BY THE LADDER, NOT THE WORD (§B3): a second banner, 'Loan', sits on printed line 7 and the 6,000.00 Jim Phelps entry beneath it is the loan; it IS an itemized contribution row, because the schedule's own subtotal does not close without it and the cover books the beginning balance at 15,609.16 (a real prior balance, not a slot for this loan). ⚠ A FILER INCONSISTENCY ON THE COVER, transcribed and NOT adjudicated: line 1 Column A prints 8357.14 while line 4 — which the form says is copied from line 1 Column A — prints 8,357.41, a digit transposition, and the filer then carried the transposed figure into line 5 (15,609.16 + 8,357.41 = 23,966.57 as printed; with 8,357.14 it would be 23,966.30). The SCHEDULE closes on 8,357.14 and that is the anchor; both cover figures are recorded here as the document prints them. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 81,188.78 — a genuine cycle cumulative on this 30-days-after-Primary report — and is never summed as an increment.

in_kind_convention: monetary-PLUS-in-kind on the contributions side; not applicable on the expenditures side. Tested on BOTH sides of THIS filing (§G1) and not inherited: the contributions side closes only WITH the 1,607.14 item the filer banner-headed 'In kind:' (cash-only leaves 6,750.00 against a printed 8,357.14), while Schedule B marks no in-kind at all and closes at 8,324.19 under either reading. Note the contrast inside this one chunk — Ellingson 2018 EXCLUDES its in-kind row from Column A and McCabe 2018 includes hers twice over.
escalation_note: One escalation, on the p3 line-1 payee cell, which runs the payee and an appended purpose together across the column boundary; a 1200 dpi strip crop reads 'Richard Jaussi   For Chapstick' with the mailing line written above and beside it. No AMOUNT was in doubt on this filing: both schedules close to the cent on their own printed subtotals and totals, which under the arithmetic-outranks-glyphs rule settles every figure. The other crops recorded in the frames are geometry proofs, including the two that show the banner lines carry no amount.

2.measure_note: legacy_colAB UNDERLINE form, text ABOVE its rule; the page is essentially square (skew -0.1, drift 0.13) so the full-width rowbands.py ladder is reliable and was used: 17 rules 21.70 / 25.61 / 29.55 / 33.43 / 37.32 / 41.20 / 45.07 / 48.91 / 52.80 / 56.75 / 60.66 / 64.50 / 68.39 / 72.23 / 76.14 / 80.05 / 83.98 at pitch 3.89, four segments each giving the column bands; row 1 has no rule above it and is extrapolated one pitch up to 17.81. SEVENTEEN lines (§H1). ⚠ ONLY FOUR OF THE EIGHT USED LINES ARE ENTRIES — this page carries BOTH of the §E3 banner-line traps at once: printed line 4 holds the words 'In kind:' and printed line 7 holds 'Loan', each written in the name column with no date and no amount, and printed line 3 holds an address continuation. So the four real entries sit on lines 1, 2, 5 and 8, and no arithmetic gate could have revealed that. FOUR-CROP PROOF at 1200 dpi --value: row 1 pct:82.0,17.81,11.5,3.89@p2 rendered the printed 'Amount' header over '250-00' (the §A1 first-entry control — the filer did begin on line 1); row 4 pct:82.0,29.55,11.5,3.88@p2 rendered an EMPTY amount cell, which is what a banner line looks like and is the proof it publishes no row; row 8 pct:82.0,45.07,11.5,3.84@p2 rendered '6000-00' (the recorded last entry); and the §B5 one-past-the-end control on row 9 rendered an EMPTY band — nothing continues below (§F1 ruled out), and no band is ~2x pitch (§F6/§H3 ruled out).

3.measure_note: Same form, and this sheet is perfectly square (skew 0.0, drift 0.0): 17 rules 23.36 ... 85.55 at pitch 3.89, row 1 extrapolated one pitch up to 19.47. THREE-CROP PROOF at 1200 dpi --value: row 1 pct:82.0,19.47,11.5,3.89@p3 rendered the 'Amount' header over '700-00'; row 5 pct:82.0,35.02,11.5,3.87@p3 rendered '800.00' (the last transcribed row); and the §B5 one-past-the-end control on row 6 rendered an EMPTY band.

notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'Jim Phelps' (handwritten), party 'Republican', residence Alpine; Office Seeking written simply 'Sheriff', which agrees with index.csv's channel label 'County Sheriff'. index.csv names no candidate; the page face supplies it. Report type: '30 Days after the Primary Election (if eliminated at the Primary)' is the box ticked — consistent with the index period label 'Out at Primary'. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS AN HONEST BLANK: NEITHER 'Yes' nor 'No' is ticked and the date line beside 'Yes' is empty; nothing was inferred. Signed and dated 7-13-18, with the same date written in the Date of Report box on all three inner sheets; the clerk's 'For Office Use Only' box is empty but a faint bleed-through machine stamp reading JUL 13 2018 PM 4:10 shows through the cover. ⚠ THE SUMMARY PAGE IS BOUND LAST, NOT SECOND (§H6): the four pages are cover (unfoliated) / Schedule A 'Page 1 of 3' / Schedule B 'Page 2 of 3' / SUMMARY PAGE 'Page 3 of 3'. The module's variant table predicts p2 for legacy_colAB; here it is p4, and it was located by its printed 'SUMMARY PAGE' heading. The foliation is internally consistent and says the document is complete as filed. FORM STOCK: the cover is the county-only title 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' with the Code 2-5 & 17-16-6.5 citation (its side rail nonetheless reads 'County & Local School Candidates'), and all three inner sheets are strap-lined '2018 County & Local School Candidates' — GENUINELY 2018-DATED STOCK in a THIRD 2018 wording, distinct from the '2018 County Candidate' and '2018 County Candidates' straplines on the Ellingson and Spencer filings in this same chunk. Schedule B's payee column is headed 'Provider/Vendor' and there is no Purpose column. THE ROW-INDEX FINDING WORTH CARRYING FORWARD: Schedule A carries TWO §E3 banner lines in one page — 'In kind:' on printed line 4 and 'Loan' on printed line 7 — each a section header in the name column with no date and no figure, each consuming a printed line and publishing no row, and each crop-proved to have an empty amount cell. Together with the address continuation on line 3 they push the four real entries onto lines 1, 2, 5 and 8; NO arithmetic gate could have detected any of that, since the sums are unaffected. The same two banners are also what make the in-kind and loan classifications legible, and both were then decided by the ladder rather than by the words. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: columns assigned by CONTENT against the printed headings. Two contribution rows put a NOTE where the address belongs ('received through Pay Pal', 'Paid direct to YESCO Signs') and one expenditure row runs its appended purpose past the payee column's edge — all recorded on their rows, none of them an inversion that makes a column unassignable, so nothing is withheld. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted and prints full mailing lines for most donors and every vendor; each was reduced to city/state at READ TIME on the contributions side, expenditure rows carry no address field in this record, and no street line was written into any field or note.
